description: Land Title Settlement Department - Beliaththa West, Beliaththa D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad Map No. (24/55052)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) and providing detailed land parcel information including cadastral maps, parcel numbers, extents, and certificate of title numbers. It involves the registration of land titles under the Registration of Title Act and is issued by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement, making it clearly a land-related gazette under Type 4 classification.
